Definition: of Hebrew origin (H4031); Magog, a foreign nation, i.e. (figuratively) an Antichristian party:--Magog.
BiblicalUsage: Magog is the far northern nation of the last battle, named once in the New Testament, in Revelation 20:8, where Satan goes out to deceive Gog and Magog and gather them together to battle.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Revelation 20:8 is the end of every proud alliance against God: gathered in number as the sand of the sea, and still doomed.
